title: Assam District Gazetteers: Vol. V - Darrang

title_as: অসম জিলা গেজেটিয়াৰ: পঞ্চম খণ্ড - দৰং
author: B. C. Allen, C.S.
provenance: Pioneer Press, Allahabad; Government of Eastern Bengal and Assam; DLI Archive 2015.463808
description: Comprehensive imperial gazetteer of Darrang District, North Bank of the Brahmaputra, covering historical administrative structures, Tai-Ahom sovereign grants, Buddhist religious sanctuaries, cross-border trade duars, and agricultural systems.
